nucleus_use_cd.note: mapped through the code table in sd_common.js; the raw code itself has no lexicon field

qual_class_shape.note: only the first character (framing) maps; quality class and shape have no lexicon field

docdate.reason: MMDDYY with a two-digit year that fits two centuries; left null

situs_juris.reason: CN is the unincorporated county: no municipality

addition_area.reason: no lexicon field for added area

apn_8.reason: first eight digits of the APN; derivable, no lexicon field

baths.reason: count only; same layout limitation as bedrooms

bedrooms.reason: count only; lexicon needs one layout record per room with non-null is_finished / is_exterior

multi.reason: assessor mapping flag; no lexicon field

nucleus_situs_thru_nbr.reason: address range end; no lexicon field

nucleus_zone_cd.reason: assessor generalized zone, not a zoning designation; property.zoning left null

overlay_juris.reason: jurisdiction by map overlay; duplicates situs_juris

ownerocc.reason: owner-occupied flag; no lexicon field (and the layer has no owner to attach it to)

par_view.reason: Y/N flag; lexicon lot.view needs the kind of view

pool.reason: Y/N flag; a lexicon pool is a layout record with required fields the source lacks

sub_type.reason: SanGIS parcel sub-type code; no lexicon field

submap.reason: subdivision / parcel map number; no lexicon field

taxstat.reason: taxable / non-taxable flag; no field in the lexicon tax class

tranum.reason: tax rate area number; no lexicon field in the classes used

x_coord.reason: State Plane centroid; the WGS84 centroid is written instead

y_coord.reason: State Plane centroid; the WGS84 centroid is written instead

year_effective.reason: two-digit year; layer metadata: "Do Not use the effective date to determine the age of the property". Not written to property_structure_built_year or property_effective_built_year
